scope: Retain provisional tracked guide geometry while existing background repair or full analysis calculates a current column.

screenGap.definition: first sampled closing-brace text/border at its new column to first sampled vertical guide at the corresponding new column
screenGap.environment: IC 2024.2.6; Linux amd64 emulation on arm64; Xvfb96; 120 Hz requested capture, original frame timestamps

limitations: Screen measurements are descriptive, one session per revision; no native macOS or rapid typing latency guarantee.
All 24 screen actions are included; both maxima occurred on the first Tab. Sampling intervals have a median of about 8.3 ms.
SDK action timings measure document writes, not physical key input or screen latency. Return-to-correct observations include polling and worker quiescence.
The paired-ratio median differs from the ratio of aggregate JVM medians; EDT and inherited coroutine allocations are separate scopes.
Original captures, diagnostic logs and full raw evidence remain local; this file contains aggregate experiment data only.
